articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Kohl’s Corporation (NYSE: KSS) (“Kohl’s” or the “Company”) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.125 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable December 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 9, 2026. About Kohl’s Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) is a leading omnichannel retailer built on a foundation that combines great brands, incredible value and convenience for our customers. Kohl’s is uniquely positioned to deliver against its long-term strategy and its purpose to take care of families’ realest moments. Kohl's serves millions of families in its more than 1,100 stores in 49 states, online at Kohls.com, and through the Kohl's App. With a large national footprint, Kohl’s is committed to making a positive impact in the communities it serves. articles.summary: Kohl’s Corporation (NYSE: KSS) (“Kohl’s” or the “Company”) today reported results for the third quarter ended October 31, 2026. Net sales increased 1.3% and comparable sales increased 1.2% Gross margin increased 145 basis points Tax benefit of $137 million or $1.16 per diluted share recognized in the quarter Diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of $2.15 for the quarter Includes gain on sale of real estate of $61 million or $0.39 per diluted share Includes tax benefit of $137 million or $1.16 per diluted share Includes tariff refund benefit of $45 million or $0.28 per diluted share Raises full year 2026 financial outlook Michael Bender, Kohl’s Chief Executive Officer, said, “In the third quarter, we returned to top-line growth with a positive 1.2% comparable sales performance.
